title: Annotatio VI §.VI (4): Wittenberg Concord 1536 — Reformed said to concede Indigni Oral
pass_a_gloss: Finally FOURTH they put forward: that Oral Eating of Christ’s body by the Impious was once conceded by the Reformed, namely in the Formula of the Wittenberg Concord sanctioned in the Year 1536 and subscribed by many of the Reformed, in Chytraeus, History of the Augsburg Confession p. 680 — nay approved by the Swiss, Crocius confessing in Comment. on the Augustan Conf. pp. 100 & 107.
pass_b_english: Fourth press: the Reformed once conceded Impious Oral eating in the Wittenberg Concord of 1536 (Chytraeus; Swiss approval per Crocius).
source_text: Denique QUARTO obtendunt: A Reformatis Impiorum Oralem corporis Christi Manducationem concessam olim esse, in Formula nempe Concordiæ Wittebergensis Anno 1536. sancitæ, & à Reformatorum pluribus subscripta, apud Chytræum, Histor. Aug. Confess. pag. 680. quin Helvetiis approbatæ, fatente Crocio in Comment. August. Conf. pag. 100. & 107.
